dialogue_texts: Ugh... even my scales are scorched. You really are as persistent as the legends say, Queen of Gaps.
A siren's flame is a curious thing, but it cannot burn through the gaps of reality.
You should rest now; the Order is built on a very fragile boundary.
Go ahead... but don't say I didn't warn you.
The glohm inside is much thicker than my smoke.
It doesn't just block the path - it closes the heart.
A heart that closes is simply a boundary waiting to be reopened.
I shall begin my inspection of the manor now.
